text:
marta: Quick share — Halo7B quant sweep results. Need product/GTN recs before Monday. TL;DR: int6 => ~2.6x cost reduction vs fp16, quality delta ~-0.7% on our dialog eval. p95 latency int6=110ms vs fp16=85ms. Canaries next week?

raj: Nice. can you paste the microbench numbers?

marta: sure, raw from perf-runner:
```
config           p95(ms)   throughput(tok/s)   cost_per_1M_tok   quality_delta
fp16 (baseline)   85         12.3               $28.5             0.0%
int8              98         10.6               $18.9            -0.2%
int6              110        32.1               $11.0            -0.7%
int4 (toy)        220        60.3               $6.5             -3.4%
```
Note: throughput numbers reflect batching=32 steady-state; mem footprint int6 fits cheaper 80GB SKU.

elaine: product POV: looks promising. recommendation: default route for high-volume assistant/short-turn routes -> halo7b-int6. For high-precision longform / hallucination-sensitive routes -> halo7b-int8 or fp16. For GTN offering, ship a "Cost Saver" tier with int6 and an "Accuracy" tier with int8/fp16. Messaging must call out the small QA delta and fallback behavior.

sam: ops checklist: agree with canary next wk. rollout plan: 1) 5% traffic canary for 24h with synthetic eval probes, 2) 25% for 48h, 3) 100% if no regression above threshold. Thresholds: <0.5% quality regression overall and no >1.5% spike in hallucination metric. Also need auto-fallback to int8 on tail latency spikes.

marta: routing sketch: `if route == chat_short and qps > 200 -> halo7b-int6 else halo7b-int8`. fallback rules: `similarity_score < 0.8 -> route to int8/fp16`. Will put this into config repo.

raj: one caveat from evals: int6 shows +1.5% relative increase in factual errors on the knowledge-check slice (questions with citations). For most chat prompts it's fine, but GTN should document that. We also saw mild degradation on rare multi-turn coherence cases.

elaine: product pricing note: reflect unit-econ — int6 is ~2.6x cheaper per-token vs fp16. propose 18–25% lower list price for Cost Saver while keeping a higher SLA for Accuracy tier. GTN needs a short FAQ about tradeoffs and a sample prompt for customers to try both modes.

ops-bot: deploy-schedule: canary window booked: 2024-06-03T09:00Z -> 2024-06-03T15:00Z. Synthetic probes configured.

marta: assigning: @sam -> rollout ops + monitor dashboards, @raj -> extend eval to hallucination and citations slice, @elaine -> GTN messaging + pricing blurb. I'll draft the one-pager and a 1-slide scorecard (cost / p95 / quality delta / known-slices).

sam: sg, I'll add a tracing hook to capture per-token CPU/GPU breakdown and auto-fallback metrics.

raj: I'll run a focused 10k-sample citation test and post results here by EOD Friday.

elaine: :thumbsup: sounds good. If we align on thresholds I'll prepare the GTN onboarding checklist.

marta: thanks — aim is to have docs + scorecard ready before the Monday GTN sync.
